;; SIGMA:{ADD:1. 02, PROP: 0.01277}; run05's ETA(7) on the additive term is ;; dropped, see header note). ;; Estimation-engine validation -- crovalimab. ;; Adapted from ../../crovalimab.txt (run05) for POSTHOC individual ;; estimation with population parameters FIXED at their published values. ;; ;; run05 is a $SIMULATION-only file (no $ESTIMATION record at all) -- this ;; recasts it for estimation, otherwise keeping $PK/$DES/$ERROR verbatim. ;; One deliberate omission, already documented in src/model.js as a stated ;; simplification: run05's $OMEGA item 7 (0.619, IIV on the additive ;; residual-error term, applied as ERR(2)*EXP(ETA(7))) is not a PK parameter ;; and is not estimated by the app -- dropped here too (ERR(2) used plain, ;; no ETA(7) multiplier), for the same reason, not a new deviation. $PROBLEM Estimation-engine validation -- crovalimab POSTHOC $INPUT ID TIME AMT RATE DV MDV EVID CMT CENS WT AGE $DATA crov.csv IGNORE=@ $SUBROUTINE ADVAN13 TOL=9 $MODEL COMP=(SC) COMP=(CENTRAL) COMP=(PERI) $PK ALLOCL = (WT/75)**0.75 ALLOV = (WT/75)**0.684 AGEKA = (-0.459)
CL = THETA(1)*ALLOCL*EXP(ETA(1)) V2 = THETA(2)*ALLOV*EXP(ETA(2)) Q = THETA(3)*ALLOCL*EXP(ETA(3)) V3 = THETA(4)*ALLOV*EXP(ETA(4)) KA = THETA(5)*((AGE/36)**AGEKA)*EXP(ETA(5))
LOGITF1 = LOG(THETA(6)/(1-THETA(6))) + ETA(6) F1 = 1/(1+EXP(-LOGITF1))
S2 = V2 K12 = KA K23 = Q/V2 K32 = Q/V3 K20 = CL/V2
$DES DADT(1) = -K12*A(1) DADT(2) = -K23*A(2) - K20*A(2) + K12*A(1) + K32*A(3) DADT(3) = -K32*A(3) + K23*A(2)
;; With LIKE, $SIGMA may not be present -- residual variance carried as two ;; FIXED thetas instead (proportional + additive, matching src/model.js's $ERROR CROVAL = A(2)/V2 IPRED = CROVAL SD = SQRT(THETA(7)*IPRED*IPRED + THETA(8)) IF (CENS.EQ.0) THEN Y = (1/SQRT(6.283185307179586*SD*SD)) * EXP(-0.5*((DV-IPRED)/SD)**2) ELSE Y = PHI((DV-IPRED)/SD) ENDIF
$THETA 0.0791 FIX ; 1 CL L/day 3.23 FIX ; 2 V2 L (app's "V1") 0.168 FIX ; 3 Q L/day 2.32 FIX ; 4 V3 L (app's "V2") 0.126 FIX ; 5 KA 1/day 0.83 FIX ; 6 F1 fraction 0.01277 FIX ; 7 SIGMA proportional variance 1.02 FIX ; 8 SIGMA additive variance $OMEGA 0.0424 FIX ; 1 CL 0.0502 FIX ; 2 V2 ("V1") 0.341 FIX ; 3 Q 0.498 FIX ; 4 V3 ("V2") 0.147 FIX ; 5 KA 1.35 FIX ; 6 F1 (logit) $ESTIMATION METHOD=1 LAPLACE LIKE NOABORT MAXEVAL=0 PRINT=1 POSTHOC
